method: Median local timings on isolated copies of the journal, with warm caches; no live browser orders. The live dataset grew from 201 to 202 rounds during measurement.

changing_atomic_write.note: Separate comparison using identical copies and a different field value on every write.

notes: Cache entries invalidate on file identity, size, or modification-time change.
All new order messages are archived in order_status.sqlite3; Older logs retrieves previous pages.
No changes to source polling intervals, quote-age limits, or order checks.
